name: iwo3-api-vendor
description: Bundled Node-side dependencies for the IWO3 FastAPI runtime. The Stitch MCP stdio proxy lives here so Railway/Streamlit-Cloud deploys can spawn it as a child process from Python without needing a sidecar container or a local IWO2 checkout. Versions pinned to the same releases IWO2 ships with so behavior is reproducible.
